materials: Add the following reagents to a tube. Total 10ul 30ul 50ul DNA 0.4ug 1.2ug 2ug Enzyme 0.2ul 0.6ul 1ul Buffer(10*) 1ul 3ul 5ul ddwater Fill the rest with water
DNA product concentrations were measured using Nano
Add the following reagents to a tube: Total 10ul 30ul 50ul DNA product 0.4ug 1.2ug 2ug CIP(NEB) 0.2ul 0.6ul 1ul Cutsmart(10*) 1ul 3ul 5ul ddwater Fill the rest with water
Add the following reagents to a tube. Total 10ul 30ul 50ul DNA 0.4ug 1.2ug 2ug Enzyme 1 0.2ul 0.6ul 1ul Enzyme 2 0.2ul 0.6ul 1ul Buffer(10*) 1ul 3ul 5ul ddwater Fill the rest with water
Add the following reagents to a tube. Total 10ul 30ul 50ul DNA product 0.4ug 1.2ug 2ug DpnI(NEB) 0.2ul 0.6ul 1ul Cutsmart(10*) 1ul 3ul 5ul ddwater Fill the rest with water

steps.title: Mix Reaction
steps.instruction: Pipette the reaction mixture up and down thoroughly to ensure homogeneity.

steps.title: Incubate for Digestion
steps.instruction: Incubate the mixture at 37℃ for approximately 2 hours (adjust timing based on the specific enzymes used).

steps.title: Heat Inactivate Enzyme
steps.instruction: Incubate the reaction at 65℃ for approximately 20 minutes (adjust timing based on the specific enzymes used).

steps.title: Purify Digestion Products
steps.instruction: Purify the enzyme digestion products using the Cycle Pure Kit D6492 (OMEGA bio-tek).
